title: Duel Decks: Phyrexia vs. the Coalition: card flavor text

entities.name: Squee
entities.description: A goblin who lost his appetite for bugs after encountering Phyrexian battleflies.

entities.name: Phyrexia
entities.description: The plane of Phyrexia, which wastes nothing and whose scriptures say it evolved from void.

entities.name: Gix
entities.description: A Phyrexian figure who, according to Xantcha, wants puppets to entertain his madness.

entities.name: Xantcha
entities.description: A Phyrexian outcast who criticizes Gix.

entities.name: Kerrick
entities.description: One who used parts from one beast to build another.

entities.name: Yawgmoth
entities.description: The Father of Machines, praised in the Phyrexian Scriptures, who saw Phyrexia's perfection and began the Grand Evolution.

entities.name: Phyrexian Scriptures
entities.description: Phyrexian holy writings praising the Father of Machines.

entities.name: Grand Evolution
entities.description: The process begun when Yawgmoth saw Phyrexia's perfection.

entities.name: Kaervek
entities.description: A speaker who says the secrets of Phyrexia are expensive.

entities.name: Volrath
entities.description: One who warned Greven to have no illusions about free will.

entities.name: Greven
entities.description: One warned by Volrath about free will.

entities.name: Dominaria
entities.description: A plane overrun by Phyrexians and plague.

entities.name: Jhoira
entities.description: A master artificer who calls fire the universal language.

entities.name: Multani
entities.description: A being who reflected on nature's beauty as Phyrexians descended.

entities.name: Urza
entities.description: A speaker who says great peril demands formidable weaponry.

entities.name: Llanowar
entities.description: An elven land with seven elfhames, or kingdoms, each with its own ruler.

entities.name: Phyrexians
entities.description: The creatures of Phyrexia, who descended upon and spread across Dominaria.

entities.name: Onean
entities.description: A place whose children's rhyme describes the Phyrexian hulk.

entities.name: Jamuraa
entities.description: A land with an expression comparing things to a necromancer's kiss.

events.summary: Squee encounters Phyrexian battleflies and loses his appetite for bugs.
events.quote: After encountering them, Squee finally lost his appetite for bugs.

events.summary: Kerrick builds beasts from parts of other beasts.
events.quote: Kerrick used parts from one beast to build another.

events.summary: Volrath warns Greven about free will.
events.quote: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."

events.summary: As Phyrexians descend, Multani reflects on beauty that might be lost.
events.quote: As Phyrexians descended, Multani paused to reflect on the beauty that might never be seen again.

relations.quote: Gix doesn't want a people to rule but puppets to entertain his madness.

relations.note: Revered as Father of Machines in Phyrexian scripture.
relations.quote: Great Yawgmoth, Father of Machines, saw its perfection.
I've journeyed across Dominaria. Phyrexians are everywhere.

relations.note: Volrath controls Greven and warns him about free will.
relations.quote: "Have no illusions," Volrath warned Greven, "about free will."
